prompts.title: 焦橙色背景下时尚男士的电影感肖像
prompts.description: 一个详细的文本提示，用于生成一个时尚男士的半身、高分辨率肖像。该提示详细说明了服装（焦橙色圆领衫、黑色太阳镜）、姿势（手放在衣领处，略微倾斜）、灯光（电影级影棚灯光，带有强烈的柔和主光和轮廓光）以及调色板（焦橙色、铁锈色、可可色）。
prompts.content: create an image of a stylish man in a plain burnt orange crewneck shirt and glossy black rectangular sunglasses, bust-up portrait, one hand at the collar/neckline as if straightening the shirt, slight forward lean, head tilted a few degrees, gaze off-camera downward, confident “aura” calm set a seamless deep rust-to-warm chocolate studio backdrop with smooth gradient falloff light with cinematic studio lighting: strong soft key at 45° camera-left, minimal fill to keep shadows rich, subtle rim light camera-right for separation, add elegant specular highlights on the lenses use a refined palette of burnt orange, rust, and cocoa with natural skin tones shoot at eye level on a full-frame camera, 85mm lens, f/2.2, crisp texture detail, shallow depth of field, centered composition with negative space and subtle depth
prompts.translatedContent: 创作一张时尚男士的图像：他身穿纯色烧橘色圆领 T 恤，戴着亮黑色矩形太阳镜，半身像。一只手放在衣领/领口处，仿佛在整理衬衫，身体略微前倾，头部微微倾斜几度，目光向下看向镜头外。他散发着自信的“气场”，沉着冷静。背景设置为无缝的深锈色到暖巧克力色影棚背景，带有平滑的渐变光照，采用电影级影棚布光：主光为 45° 偏左的强柔光，辅光极少以保持阴影浓郁，右侧有微妙的轮廓光以增加分离度，镜片上添加优雅的镜面高光。使用精致的调色板，包括烧橘色、锈色和可可色，搭配自然的肤色。以平视视角使用全画幅相机拍摄，85mm 镜头，f/2.2 光圈，细节纹理清晰，景深较浅，居中构图，留有负空间和微妙的景深。

prompts.title: 梦幻奢华香水自然摄影提示
prompts.description: 一个旨在生成超逼真、高端产品摄影的综合性提示，用于展示置身于宁静自然天堂中的奢华香水瓶。它详细说明了香水瓶的细节、环境（瀑布、茂盛的植物）、光线（过滤的阳光、电影般的辉光）以及营造空灵、杂志风格效果的技术规格。
prompts.content:
Ultra-realistic dreamy product photography in a serene natural paradise environment. A luxurious transparent glass perfume bottle with soft blush-toned fragrance liquid sits centered on a smooth wet stone, slightly elevated above shallow flowing water. The bottle features a minimalist matte gold cap and an elegant cream label with refined serif branding and subtle embossed detailing. Tiny water droplets rest on the glass surface, catching the light and enhancing the premium gemini feel.
In the background, a majestic waterfall cascades down moss-covered rocks, softly blurred to create depth while maintaining environmental clarity. Lush green foliage surrounds the scene, with delicate mist floating in the air and sunlight filtering through trees, creating gentle volumetric light rays.
Lighting is soft natural daylight mixed with subtle cinematic glow, producing glossy highlights on the glass and realistic reflections on the wet stone. Clean symmetrical composition with the bottle perfectly sharp in focus, shallow depth of field, highly detailed textures on water, stone, glass, and foliage. Aesthetic blends luxury fragrance advertising with ethereal nature fantasy, color palette dominated by fresh greens, soft neutrals, and crystal-clear water tones. Photorealistic 8K quality, hyper-detailed textures, premium editorial finish, high dynamic range, professional 85mm lens feel.
prompts.translatedContent:
在宁静的自然天堂环境中，拍摄超逼真、梦幻般的产品照片。一个奢华的透明玻璃香水瓶，内含柔和的腮红调香水液体，居中放置在一块光滑的湿润石头上，略高于浅浅的流水。香水瓶配有简约的哑光金色瓶盖和优雅的米色标签，上面印有精致的衬线品牌标识和微妙的浮雕细节。微小的水珠停留在玻璃表面，捕捉光线，增强了高级的双子座（gemini）质感。

背景中，雄伟的瀑布从长满苔藓的岩石上倾泻而下，柔和的虚化处理营造出景深，同时保持了环境的清晰度。郁郁葱葱的绿色植物环绕着场景，空气中弥漫着淡淡的薄雾，阳光透过树木，形成柔和的体积光线。

光线是柔和的自然日光与微妙的电影感光泽混合，在玻璃上产生光泽高光，并在湿润的石头上产生逼真的反射。构图干净对称，香水瓶完美清晰地对焦，景深较浅，水、石头、玻璃和植物的纹理高度精细。美学上融合了奢华香水广告与空灵的自然幻想，调色板以清新的绿色、柔和的中性色和水晶般清澈的水色为主。照片级 8K 画质，超精细纹理，高级编辑级效果，高动态范围，专业 85mm 镜头感。

prompts.title: 戏剧性数字绘画肖像提示
prompts.description: 一个用于生成戏剧性数字绘画肖像的提示，描绘了一位表情坚毅、充满决心的年轻女性。它指定了大胆、有质感的风格，有限的调色板（黑、白、红、黄），以及用颜料条纹分割的抽象背景，以传达抱负和自信。
prompts.content: Create a dramatic digital painting style portrait of a young woman (based on a reference image) looking upward with a strong, determined expression.The artwork should feel bold and textured, with energetic brush strokes and a limited color palette of black, white, red, and yellow. The background is split vertically with abstract red and yellow paint streaks, creating a powerful and intense mood. Focus on ambition and confidence in her gaze, capturing strength and resilience in her facial expression. The design should be clean with no text, no slogan, and no logo anywhere in the frame. The composition should feel motivational and poster-ready, high detail, 8K resolution, image aspect ratio 4:5.
prompts.translatedContent: 创作一幅戏剧性的数字绘画风格肖像，描绘一位年轻女性（基于参考图像），她向上凝视，眼神坚定而充满决心。作品应具有大胆而富有质感的特点，笔触充满活力，色彩仅限于黑、白、红、黄。背景垂直分割，抽象的红黄颜料条纹交织，营造出一种强大而紧张的氛围。重点突出她眼神中的抱负和自信，捕捉她面部表情中的力量和韧性。设计应简洁，画面中不包含任何文字、标语或标志。构图应具有激励性，适合作为海报，高细节，8K 分辨率，图像宽高比 4:5。

prompts.title: 超写实艺术时尚肖像提示词
prompts.description: 为 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 提供的详细提示，用于生成一张超现实、艺术级的时尚肖像，适合奢侈品编辑内容。该提示详细说明了拍摄对象的姿势、服装（单色天蓝色西装）、象征性的玻璃球元素、极简主义背景，以及技术相机设置（哈苏 X2D，80mm 镜头），以营造几何、静谧和科技感十足的氛围。
prompts.content:
A hyper-realistic fine art fashion portrait for a luxury editorial. The subject stands frontally, shoulders down, hands in pockets, and has a calm, detached gaze. Cool skin tone, clear facial expression. Clothing: a monochrome sky-blue suit. An additional element: a glass ball held in the hand as a symbol of control and the future. The sky-blue background is minimalist, cool, and studio-style. Dramatic directional lighting emphasizes the geometry of the image. Hasselblad X2D, XCD 80mm, shallow depth of field, focus on the face and subject.

Palette: blue, leather, white. Mood: distance, technology, silence. Vertical editorial shot. --ag 9:16 --v 7 --style raw --chaos 5 --stylize 350
prompts.translatedContent:
一张用于奢侈品杂志的超写实艺术时尚肖像。主体正面站立，双肩下垂，双手插兜，眼神平静而超然。冷色调肤色，面部表情清晰。服装：一套单色天蓝色西装。附加元素：手中握着一个玻璃球，象征着掌控与未来。天蓝色背景极简、冷峻，呈影棚风格。戏剧性的定向照明强调了图像的几何感。哈苏 X2D，XCD 80mm 镜头，浅景深，焦点集中在面部和主体。

调色板：蓝色、皮革、白色。情绪：疏离、科技、寂静。垂直杂志拍摄。--ag 9:16 --v 7 --style raw --chaos 5 --stylize 350
